name: Arden Bell
significance: Arden's event file holds the print vendor's proof sheet for the anniversary invitations, the one piece of paper Arden can produce to end a theory.
infoNote: The 'machine key' hidden in the invitation typography is nothing but ordinary registration marks from the press run, and Arden can prove it.

name: Frankie Lowell
significance: Frankie still carries the battered press badge from decades on the metro desk, the object that says 'I was there' before Frankie says a word.

name: Tessa Quill
significance: Tessa's non-negotiable rule: no account of R is acceptable if it turns laborers and sources into disposable scenery.

name: Jules Kwan
significance: Jules keeps the printed succession message in a carefully chosen envelope, treating the paper as both evidence and costume.

name: Dr. Mira Sen
significance: Mira's founding pitch for Parallax, that its systems are civic infrastructure rather than privatized power, is the phrase she has built a career defending.

name: Eli Navarro
significance: The line Eli reads off the log cards whenever precision starts slipping: the system could maintain a persona, which is not the same as showing that it did.

name: Maren Okafor
significance: Maren's standing set of questions for any abstraction: who was paid, who consented, who can be fired, and who bears the risk.

name: Edi Velez
significance: Edi's professional creed: an actor supplies breath, and supplying breath has never been the same thing as authorship.

name: Rafi Calderón
significance: The recurring $4.50 line in Rafi's ledger is a bacon, egg, and cheese, ordered the same way for years.
infoNote: The mysterious repeating $4.50 that Kit Rakes has broadcast as an encoded signal is a breakfast sandwich, and Rafi can demolish the ledger-cipher theory line by line with the book in hand.

name: Dee Nowak
significance: Dee received an automated building claims notice nine days before the party about a third-party delivery robot at the service crossing.
infoNote: A delivery robot contacted a cyclist at the service crossing nine days before the party, off the unit's logged route, and the unnamed rider who declined medical attention is someone Rafi or Inez may be able to place.
